description: Is this URL or API working right now? Returns ok/down, HTTP status, time to first byte and total time, redirects followed, size, content type, server, HTTPS and security headers, the page title, and for JSON APIs whether the response is valid JSON and its top-level keys. A site that is down is an answer, not an error. Price: $0.005 USDC on Base per successful call (x402).
